"I once trained under this town's lord,
  Master Don Rodrigo. Since those days,
  the town hasn't changed at all.

"I trained with Master and my comrades,
  and the sea taught me nature's harshness.
  This whole town was my teacher.

"W-well then, I'll pick flowers
  in the pretty field outside.
  Call me when you're done~♪

"I've wondered for a long time...
  Aren't you Master Rodrigo's son,
  Norberto?

"...You noticed faster than I thought.
  Well, now I've been found out.
  It's been a while, H-e-n-d-r-i-k♪

"I can't believe it. The serious Norberto
  has changed like this...
  Master will be quite surprised.

"...Still, you tried to run away just now.
  Don't you wish to see Master Rodrigo?

"I don't know what happened between you.
  There must be deep reasons. But now
  Erdwin's Lantern has fallen.

"To face that black sun, shouldn't you
  reconcile with Master Rodrigo
  and ask for his strength?

"...You're right, Hendrik.
  Papa would surely lend me his strength...

"{var:1}, darling, I've decided.
  I'm scared, but I'll be brave
  and see Papa. Come to the mansion?

"Oh, {var:1}, darling, you tease.
  Saying that, you'll come with me, right?

"Thanks! That's what I like to hear!
  ...All right, let's go see Papa!
